title: P.V. Sindhu Reaches French Open Final After 13-Year Wait
indian_angle: P.V. Sindhu, a prominent Indian shuttler, has ended a long wait to reach a Super 750 final, showcasing her continued elite performance.
summary: P.V. Sindhu overcame Hina Akechi in a thrilling semi-final match at the French Open 2026, securing her spot in the final after a 13-year gap since her last appearance.

title: Thulasimathi-Manasi Clinch Badminton Gold at Asian Para Games
indian_angle: This victory contributed to India's best-ever gold haul at the Asian Para Games, highlighting the success of Indian para-badminton athletes.
summary: Thulasimathi Murugesan and Manasi Girishchandra secured the women’s doubles SL3-SU5 title at the Asian Para Games 2026, adding a significant gold medal to India's tally.

title: India Achieves Best-Ever Fourth Place Finish at Asian Para Games
indian_angle: India's strong performance at the Asian Para Games, including multiple badminton golds, led to its best-ever fourth-place finish in the medal tally.
summary: India concluded the Asian Para Games 2026 in Aichi-Nagoya with its best-ever performance, securing fourth place in the final medal tally, a feat bolstered by triumphs across various disciplines including badminton.
